name: Rampart Mark Four
description: The Rampart Mark Four was a bomber model manufactured by Elsinore-Cordova Engineering for the Galactic Republic that saw use during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire. Primarily a minelayer, the Rampart Mark Four featured extended ammunition caches and room for two types of mines, along with the baseline defenses of most gunships, a moderate sensor range, and particularly good communication systems.
